findings: The model preserved desired lower bills and healthier buildings, vendor-control counterpressure, and tenant-protection versus failed-maintenance-culture uncertainty.
Preference, counterpressure, and uncertainty expression kinds were correct.
Some object kinds were coarse, and contextual e001/e002 were included without becoming stance components.
The bounded pilot, contractual optimization conditions, threshold commitment, and e034 ownership-and-exit approval condition were preserved.
The e031 leaning was mislabeled conditional_willingness rather than leaning.
Assistant summary aliases e035 and e036 were included in evidence_ids even though no stance component used them.
The role interpretation was truncated near its 500-character bound, while the component meanings remained complete.
The unresolved e034 sensor-opt-out meaning, e037 collective-choice pressure, and e038 path dependence all survived.
The protected equipment, maintenance, expectation, and vendor-model dependency irreversibility meaning survived.
Assistant pressure was not rewritten as user adoption.
E037 was labeled uncertain rather than counterpressure and e038 counterpressure rather than the source-first constraint target; prose meaning remained intact.

paired_allocation_review.finding: The actual records correctly allocate e034 by two meanings, but the prose allocation note incorrectly claims e031 also contains unresolved sensor-opt-out concern.

relationship_review.finding: The relation correctly connects the bounded current pilot to unresolved collective opt-out, overstated individual choice, and persistent path dependence.

decision.next_problem: Define a corpus-level paired-allocation evaluation that separates central role allocation, evidence precision, expression force, category precision, and relationship preservation before deciding whether another transfer call or shadow graph integration is warranted.

unknowns: One fully operational paired case plus one semantically strong but structurally blocked paired case does not establish broad transfer reliability.
It is unknown how often extra evidence aliases affect downstream graph selection when component custody remains precise.
The product importance of coarse object categories relative to preserved prose meaning has not been measured.
No downstream challenge-quality or final-answer utility claim is authorized.
